<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #ffffff; --bg-alt: #f5f5f7; --ink: #1d1d1f; --muted: #6e6e73; --line: #d2d2d7;
    --card: #ffffff; --accent: #c2410c; --accent-2: #f97316; --link: #0066cc;
    --dark: #000000; --dark-ink: #f5f5f7; --dark-muted: #a1a1a6; --dark-card: #1c1c1e;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
      --bg: #000000; --bg-alt: #0b0b0d; --ink: #f5f5f7; --muted: #a1a1a6; --line: #2c2c2e;
      --card: #1c1c1e; --link: #2997ff;
    }
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink);
         font: 17px/1.47 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
         letter-spacing: -.011em; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
  a { color: var(--link); text-decoration: none; }
  a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .wrap { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 22px; }
  .center { text-align: center; }

  /* Glass nav */
  nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; height: 48px;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 72%, transparent);
        backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(20px);
        border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--line) 60%, transparent); }
  nav .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 100%; }
  .brand { font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: -.02em; }
  .brand:hover { text-decoration: none; }
  nav ul { display: flex; gap: 28px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-size: 13px; }
  nav ul a { color: var(--ink); opacity: .8; }
  nav ul a:hover { opacity: 1; text-decoration: none; }
  .pill { display: inline-block; background: var(--accent); color: #fff !important; opacity: 1 !important;
          padding: 5px 13px; border-radius: 980px; font-weight: 500; }
  /* iPhone touch-scroll nav enabled */

  /* Hero */
  .hero { padding: 120px 0 40px; overflow: hidden; }
  .kicker { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); margin: 0 0 8px; }
  .hero h1 { font-size: clamp(56px, 11vw, 120px); line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.045em; margin: 0;
             background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--ink) 30%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 55%, transparent));
             -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }
  .hero p { font-size: clamp(21px, 2.6vw, 28px); line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.02em;
            color: var(--muted); max-width: 760px; margin: 22px auto 34px; }
  .ctas { display: flex; gap: 22px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; font-size: 19px; }
  .btn { display: inline-block; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 980px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 17px; }
  .btn:hover { text-decoration: none; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, #fff); }
  .chev::after { content: " ›"; }

  /* Orb */
  .orb { position: relative; height: 340px; margin: 70px auto 0; max-width: 900px; }
  .orb::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; margin: auto; width: 340px; height: 340px; border-radius: 50%;
                 background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #fed7aa, var(--accent-2) 35%, var(--accent) 60%, #431407 100%);
                 filter: blur(.5px); box-shadow: 0 60px 120px -20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 55%, transparent);
                 animation: float 9s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .orb span { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); font-size: 64px; font-weight: 800;
              color: #fff; letter-spacing: -.04em; text-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }
  @keyframes float { 50% { transform: translateY(-14px) scale(1.02); } }
  @media (max-width: 480px) { .orb { height: 260px; } .orb::before { width: 250px; height: 250px; } .orb span { font-size: 48px; } }

  section { padding: 110px 0; }
  .alt { background: var(--bg-alt); }
  .dark { background: var(--dark); color: var(--dark-ink); }
  .dark .muted { color: var(--dark-muted); }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(40px, 6vw, 64px); line-height: 1.06; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.035em; margin: 0 0 18px; }
  .lead { font-size: clamp(19px, 2.2vw, 24px); line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .dark .lead { color: var(--dark-muted); }
  .grad { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-2), #ef4444 50%, #a855f7);
          -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }

  /* Big stats */
  .bigstats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 40px 20px; margin-top: 70px; }
  .bigstats b { display: block; font-size: clamp(48px, 7vw, 80px); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.05em; line-height: 1; }
  .bigstats span { display: block; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--dark-muted); }
  @media (max-width: 760px) { .bigstats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }

  /* Tiles */
  .tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; margin-top: 60px; }
  @media (max-width: 860px) { .tiles { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
  @media (max-width: 560px) { .tiles { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .tile { background: var(--card); border-radius: 28px; padding: 34px 30px; min-height: 230px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
          box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.04); transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow .4s; }
  .tile:hover { transform: scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.10); }
  .tile .n { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.045em; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: auto; }
  .tile h3 { font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin: 26px 0 6px; }
  .tile p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }

  /* Principles */
  .principles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 34px; margin-top: 60px; text-align: left; }
  @media (max-width: 860px) { .principles { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
  @media (max-width: 520px) { .principles { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .principles .ic { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px;
                    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 14%, transparent); color: var(--accent); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; }
  .principles h3 { font-size: 19px; margin: 0 0 6px; letter-spacing: -.015em; }
  .principles p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; }

  /* Desks marquee */
  .desks { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 44px; }
  .desks span { padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 980px; border: 1px solid #333; font-weight: 600; font-size: 17px; }

  /* Channels */
  .channels { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin-top: 56px; }
  @media (max-width: 860px) { .channels { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
  @media (max-width: 520px) { .channels { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .ch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; background: var(--card); border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px 20px; color: var(--ink);
        box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.04); transition: transform .3s, box-shadow .3s; text-align: left; }
  .ch:hover { text-decoration: none; transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.10); }
  .ch .ico { flex: none; width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 13px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; }
  .ch .ico svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: currentColor; }
  .yt { background: #ff0000; } .fb { background: #1877f2; } .ig { background: linear-gradient(45deg,#feda75,#d62976 50%,#4f5bd5); } .web { background: var(--ink); }
  .ch strong { display: block; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -.015em; }
  .ch small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }

  /* Contact */
  .formcard { background: var(--card); border-radius: 28px; padding: 40px; max-width: 680px; margin: 56px auto 0; text-align: left;
              box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.04); }
  @media (max-width: 520px) { .formcard { padding: 26px 20px; } }
  form { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
  .row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  @media (max-width: 560px) { .row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  label { display: grid; gap: 7px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
  input, select, textarea { font: inherit; font-size: 17px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--bg-alt); border: 1px solid transparent;
                            border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; width: 100%; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s; }
  input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--link); background: var(--bg); }
  textarea { min-height: 140px; resize: vertical; }
  button.btn { border: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; width: 100%; padding: 15px; font-size: 17px; }
  .status { margin: 0; text-align: center; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted); min-height: 1.4em; }
  .fine { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; margin: 4px 0 0; }
  .hp { position: absolute; left: -9999px; }

  footer { background: var(--bg-alt); color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; padding: 22px 0 34px; }
  footer .wrap { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; justify-content: space-between; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 18px; }

  /* Scroll reveal */
  .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); transition: opacity 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
  .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; transition: none; } .orb::before { animation: none; } }
</style>
